summary:
Turn 9 built and submitted an exploration for the active recovery-vbal Candidate.

Harness. Two real Replica values are constructed in-package (a recovering replica 0 holding only a default record for instance (1,0), and a peer 1 whose record for that instance is COMMITTED at vbal 0 with a real PUT command). SendMsg goes through per-peer buffers and every message is delivered through the real Marshal/Unmarshal form into the real handlers: the recovering replica calls startRecoveryForInstance, its Prepare reaches the peer, and the peer's PrepareReply comes back. The harness prints CA_EVENT records and asserts nothing about the property.

What the local construction run showed (construction knowledge only, not evidence). The self PrepareReply reports VBallot 3, the newly made ballot, while the leader bookkeeping was seeded with the record's old vbal -1; the peer's reply reports Status COMMITTED at vbal 0; the resolution leaves lb.status PREACCEPTED and the instance PREACCEPTED with a NOOP command (first op NONE), the COMMITTED vector is not adopted, and the recovering replica emits a PreAccept (code 11) rather than resolving from the committed reply. So the mechanism the last turn hypothesised is reproduced end to end with only real handlers.

Why it matters. This is the first construction-level witness that a replica holding a default record can ignore a remote reply that reports the instance already committed. The follow-on reasoning (to be checked, not asserted) is that the resulting accept phase cannot gather a majority that excludes the committed replica, because handleAccept on an already-COMMITTED record refuses to store the new attributes and replies with its own ballot, which handleAcceptReply drops; that would make this a blocked-catch-up liveness failure rather than a divergence, and it needs its own verification before being treated as a result. The exploration was submitted so the trusted runner reproduces the same events in a clean copy; no formal check, obligation or map change was submitted this turn, and no requirement, premise or prior result was weakened.
